US To Sell $30 Bln In 2-Year FRNs Wed
WASHINGTON (Dow Jones)--The U.S. Treasury plans to auction $30 billion in 2-year frns Wednesday.
The debt will settle on Nov. 02, 2026 and will mature Oct. 31, 2028.
The Federal Reserve holds $23.668 billion of maturing securities for its own account. Amounts bid by the Federal Reserve banks for their own account will be in addition to the public offering amount.

Noncompetitive tenders for the 2-year frns, available in minimum denominations of $100, must be received by 11:00 AM Eastern Time Wednesday. Competitive tenders available in minimum denominations of $100, must be received by 11:30 AM Eastern Time.
(Data provided by the U.S. Treasury Dept.)
